meta.name: customize
meta.description: Add new capabilities or modify NanoClaw behavior. Use when user wants to add channels (Telegram, Slack, email input), change triggers, add integrations, modify the router, or make any other customizations. This is an interactive skill that asks questions to understand what the user wants.

copy.tagline: 为 NanoClaw 添加新通道或修改行为
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在定制 NanoClaw 的行为或集成新通道。
copy.tagline_en: Add new channels or modify NanoClaw behavior
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are customizing NanoClaw's behavior or integrating new channels.

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 会先问你几个问题,弄清你想怎么改,然后帮你改动 NanoClaw 的配置——比如新增聊天渠道(Telegram、Slack、邮件等)、调整触发词、接入外部服务。
howto.when: 当你提出给 NanoClaw 增加新功能或修改行为时触发,例如添加渠道(Telegram、Slack 等)、改触发词、加集成,或改路由。

say.text: 帮我把 Telegram 加为输入渠道
say.note: 它会先问渠道对应哪个 agent 组等细节
会更新对应 agent 组的触发规则

say.text: 给指定的 agent 组加上 Google 日历集成
say.note: 若没有现成技能会配置 MCP 服务器

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will ask clarifying questions, then modify NanoClaw's config — e.g. add channels (Telegram, Slack, email), change trigger words, or integrate external services.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add capabilities or change NanoClaw behavior, such as adding channels (Telegram, Slack, etc.), changing triggers, adding integrations, or modifying the router.

say_en.text: Add Telegram as an input channel
say_en.note: It will first ask which agent group to use

say_en.text: Add a Google Calendar integration to a specific agent group
say_en.note: Uses an install skill or configures an MCP server
